Help me pick a laptop under 80,000 rupees for programming
12:00 AM

For programming under ₹80,000 go for 16 GB memory, a 512 GB fast drive and a recent Ryzen 5/7 or Intel Core i5/Ultra 5 chip. A graphics card isn't needed unless you do AI work or games.

Memory: 16 GB is the minimum, and 32 GB is better if you run Docker or phone emulators.
Screen and keyboard: A bright 1080p screen (14 to 15.6 inch) and a keyboard you like typing on matter more than extra speed.
Battery and weight: Look for 8+ hours and under 1.8 kg if you carry it daily. A Mac with an M-series chip is also worth a look if one fits the budget.

What will you mostly build: web or app projects, or AI and games? I can then look up current options and prices for you.
